summary: The change adds a 64 KiB global JSON body limit enforced before parsing, rejects oversized declared Content-Length and streamed bodies, maps overruns to 413, applies tighter per-endpoint caps, and adds tests for declared, streamed, and boundary-sized requests.

evidence: src/http.ts:55-57 defines a 64 KiB global maximum plus 16 KiB and 32 KiB endpoint limits; src/http.ts:107-119 clamps every readJson call to the global maximum.
src/http.ts:66-105 checks declared Content-Length with BigInt and incrementally counts streamed bytes, throwing RequestBodyTooLargeError before constructing or parsing JSON.
src/passport.ts:2706-2712 converts RequestBodyTooLargeError to a 413 payload_too_large response, and endpoint calls throughout src/passport.ts apply the tighter limits.
tests/bun_test.ts:293-337 tests oversized declared Content-Length, chunked/streamed overrun, and a valid request exactly at the boundary.
